offerings.name: Walkthrough · One sales question
offerings.buyer: Illustrative small retailer with a sales export and a named owner decision.
offerings.problem: Which products account for discounting, and what should the owner investigate next?
offerings.scope: One sales export, one reporting period, one question. Data readiness check, short analysis brief and one review call. Major cleanup, new data connections and broader analysis are separately scoped.
offerings.deliverables:
Checked short brief with definitions and limitations.
One review call and a proposed next decision.
offerings.inputs:
The business question, reporting period and currency.
Customer-authorized source exports and an explanation of their fields.
Cost coverage if the question concerns product margin rather than sales.
Agreed access, sharing and handling requirements.
offerings.handoffs: Scope owner and client agree the question → analyst checks source readiness → preparation work resolves agreed issues → reviewer checks findings → scope owner discusses the next decision with the client.
offerings.acceptance:
Totals and exclusions can be traced to the supplied source.
Missing costs or records remain explicit.
The client can distinguish an observed pattern from a causal claim or forecast.
The agreed question is answered, or the evidence gap is explained.
offerings.researchNotes:
Walkthrough assumptions only; no buyer demand or market price is established.
Confirm which source fields are available and whether totals reconcile.
Time a practice delivery including cleanup, analysis, review and discussion.
Analyst covers preparation and analysis; owner covers review and client coordination.
The hourly figures are fictional planning inputs, not an agreed compensation arrangement.
offerings.sources:
Shopify report exports — workflow reference: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/reports-and-analytics/shopify-reports/report-types/custom-reports/export-reports
Shopify profit reports — cost coverage limitation: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/reports-and-analytics/shopify-reports/report-types/default-reports/profit-reports
FTC business information guide — collection, access and service-provider considerations: https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/protecting-personal-information-guide-business
offerings.nextAction: Run one timed exercise with synthetic data, then ask a prospective buyer whether the resulting decision is useful.
offerings.unit: one scoped diagnostic and review call
